core: RNA virus genome replication and translation
qualifier: host translation control by coronavirus, influenza and RSV
name: RNA virus genome replication and host translation control
rationale: All members concern RNA-virus (SARS-CoV, influenza, RSV) genome replication, viral mRNA synthesis/translation and viral manipulation of host translation, unlike confusables centred on APOBEC/ADAR editing, retroviral DNA integration or viral entry and assembly.

name: Immunoglobulin gene diversification and early B cell development
rationale: Members cover V(D)J recombination, somatic hypermutation and B cell lineage commitment/pre-B differentiation, distinguishing them from generic mismatch repair, APOBEC editing and T cell development confusables.

qualifier: midline repulsion and neuron type-specific pathfinding
name: Neuron type-specific axon guidance and midline repulsion
rationale: All members concern axon guidance, with chemorepulsion, commissural midline choice and specific neuron types (retinal, dopaminergic, serotonergic, DRG) that the receptor-signaling confusables (SLIT-ROBO, netrin, ephrin, semaphorin) lack.

name: Epithelial anion transport by SLC26 exchangers and CFTR
rationale: Members concern SLC26-mediated sulfate/iodide/oxalate exchange and CFTR chloride transport and their diseases, whereas confusables involve aquaporins, bicarbonate or cation-chloride cotransporters.

qualifier: nonsense, no-go and non-stop decay with ribosome rescue
name: Translation termination and nonsense, no-go, non-stop mRNA decay
rationale: Members cover translation termination, NMD, no-go and non-stop decay and stalled ribosome rescue, unlike confusables focused on mRNA 3' processing, nascent-peptide quality control or nuclear RNA processing.

name: M-CSF-driven monocyte, macrophage and dendritic cell differentiation
rationale: Members concern M-CSF signaling and the differentiation/proliferation of monocytes, macrophages and myeloid DCs, whereas confusables centre on granulocyte/neutrophil differentiation or CSF1 receptor signaling without differentiation.

core: Type I interferon induction by nucleic acid sensing
qualifier: RIG-I/MDA5 and IRF3/IRF7 driven IFN-alpha/beta production
name: Viral RNA sensing driving IRF3/IRF7 type I interferon production
rationale: Members cover RIG-I/MDA5 and dsRNA sensing, IRF3/IRF7 activation and positive regulation of IFN-alpha/beta production, while confusables emphasise downstream antiviral/IFN responses, viral evasion or DNA sensing.

qualifier: degron rules, ubiquitin-independent route and its negative regulation
name: Degron-rule and ubiquitin-independent proteasomal degradation and its restraint
rationale: Members concern N-end/C-end degron and ubiquitin-independent proteasomal degradation plus deubiquitinating and negative regulation of proteolysis, which confusables (stress granules, ribosome quality control, positive regulation) lack.

name: Autocrine/paracrine IL-6-family cytokine signaling via CNTF and IL-11
rationale: Members concern IL-6-type cytokine receptor-ligand interactions (CNTF, IL-11, LIF/OSM inflammatory cytokines) and autocrine/paracrine signaling, unlike confusables centred on IL-6/STAT3 itself or M-CSF signaling.

name: Monocyte antigen presentation with CD1 lipid antigens and TLR7/8
rationale: Members combine general and lipid (CD1/MHC Ib) antigen presentation with monocyte surface/TLR7-TLR8 signatures, while confusables centre on MHC class II peptide presentation and dendritic cell signatures.

core: Adrenergic control of smooth muscle contraction
qualifier: alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/Gz inhibition of adenylate cyclase
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/Gz signaling and smooth muscle contraction
rationale: Members combine adrenaline/noradrenaline signaling through adenylate cyclase-inhibiting (alpha-2, Gz) receptors with vascular, uterine, urinary and penile smooth muscle contraction, unlike confusables featuring cGMP/endothelin or cardiac contraction.

core: Amino sugar and sialic acid metabolism
name: Amino sugar, sialic acid and lysosomal ganglioside catabolism
rationale: Members cover GlcNAc, mannose and sialic acid metabolism together with lysosomal glycosphingolipid/ganglioside breakdown (HEXA/HEXB, NEU1), distinct from confusables on N-glycan synthesis, GAG degradation or glycosphingolipid biosynthesis.

core: Cholesterol efflux and reverse cholesterol transport
qualifier: LXR-regulated, limiting storage and foam cell formation
name: Regulation of cholesterol efflux, storage and reverse transport
rationale: Members regulate cholesterol efflux, storage, reverse transport and sterol homeostasis (including LXR targets and foam cell inhibition), while confusables centre on HDL particle assembly/remodeling or SREBP-driven biosynthesis.

name: Kinase inhibitor resistance of ERBB2 kinase-domain mutants
rationale: All three members describe ERBB2 kinase-domain mutants resisting specific TKIs, distinguishing them from PDGFR/ALK drug-resistance and FGFR/EGFR oncogenic signaling confusables.

qualifier: translesion polymerases and NER gap filling
name: Translesion synthesis and nucleotide excision repair gap filling
rationale: Members cover translesion synthesis by specialised polymerases and PCNA-dependent NER gap-filling, whereas confusables concern replicative DNA synthesis and base excision repair.

qualifier: with envelope protein maturation and virion assembly
name: Viral attachment, entry and envelope protein maturation
rationale: Members span viral attachment/entry and maturation of viral envelope/structural proteins with virion assembly (dengue, coronavirus, RSV, HIV), whereas each confusable lacks either the entry or the protein maturation component.

qualifier: Sertoli, Leydig and germ cell regulation
name: Testis development with Sertoli, Leydig and germ cell control
rationale: Members concern seminiferous tubule development, Sertoli and Leydig cell proliferation/differentiation and germ cell proliferation/meiosis, unlike confusables on gonadotropin hormone signaling or primordial germ cell migration.

qualifier: primitive streak, lateral plate mesoderm and gut morphogenesis
name: Primitive streak, lateral mesoderm and embryonic gut morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover primitive streak formation, lateral plate mesoderm and mesenchyme migration and hindgut/digestive tract morphogenesis, unlike confusables centred on definitive endoderm, mesendoderm or cardiac mesoderm.

core: Ammonium and carbon dioxide transmembrane transport
name: Rhesus glycoprotein ammonium and CO2 transport
rationale: All members concern ammonium or CO2 membrane transport via Rh glycoproteins, distinct from bicarbonate, aquaporin and erythrocyte gas exchange confusables.

core: DNA damage and replication stress response
qualifier: protein ADP-ribosylation and double-strand break site recruitment
name: ADP-ribosylation in DNA damage and replication stress responses
rationale: Members concern genome stability under replication stress (hydroxyurea, camptothecin, R-loops, DNA-protein crosslinks) with protein ADP-ribosylation and DSB-site recruitment that the topology/telomere confusables lack.

name: Toll-like receptor TAK1-IKK activation of canonical NF-kB
rationale: Members describe TLR4 (TRIF) and TLR7/8/9 (IRAK1/2, TRAF6) recruitment of TAK1 and IKK and positive regulation of canonical NF-kB, unlike confusables on non-canonical NF-kB, TAK1-JNK/p38 or TNFR1 signaling.

name: PDGF receptor signaling and mechanoresponsive fibroblast activation
rationale: Members cover regulation of PDGFR-alpha/beta signaling and response to PDGF together with YAP/TAZ-driven fibroblast modules, distinguishing them from Hippo-centred or general stromal/ECM confusables.

name: Linkage-specific polyubiquitin chain assembly and deubiquitination
rationale: Members concern K6/K11/K27/K29/K48/K63-linked and branched ubiquitination, E1-E2-E3 activity and USP/OTU/metalloprotease DUBs, unlike confusables on proteasome, protein quality control or autophagy.

name: Small GTPase regulation and Rab geranylgeranylation
rationale: Members concern GTPase activation/inactivation of Rab, ARF, Ral and Rho proteins and Rab prenylation, whereas confusables are dominated by Golgi/ER vesicle trafficking itself.

name: RNA polymerase I rRNA transcription and nucleolar chromatin control
rationale: Members cover Pol I initiation, promoter escape and termination plus chromatin regulators of rDNA (NoRC, B-WICH, CSB/G9a, SIRT1) and 5S rRNA Pol III transcription, distinct from confusables on Pol III/snRNA transcription, rRNA processing or translation initiation.
